messages:
maya: Heads-up — spotted S3 partner ingest logs that include KMS ciphertext plus a truncated service token fragment. Looks like partner pipeline uploaded logs with secrets. Need fast containment and a short rotation plan.

lee: Oncall — reading. Can you paste one redacted sample line (no full tokens)?

maya: sure — redacting internal ids: 
```
2026-03-23T14:02:11Z partner-ingest INFO {
  "object": "s3://partner-bucket/2026/03/23/log.gz",
  "payload": {
    "ciphertext": "CiQAXXX...AAA==",
    "service_token": "tok_aa***bb"
  }
}
```

priya: Action items (short):
1) Revoke any live service account keys for partner-ingest immediately.
2) Disable decrypt permission on the KMS key for partner principal (temporary).
3) Enable audit sink for KMS/Vault decrypt ops -> BigQuery (90d).
4) Rotate partner creds & enforce upload-side redaction.
5) Run a quick search for other buckets/objects with similar patterns.

sam: Commands I'll run now:
```
# disable key version (temporary block decrypts)
gcloud kms keys versions disable 1 --key=redwood-ingest-key --location=us-central1 --keyring=partners
# suspend service-account key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=partner-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# quick grep in GCS (metadata only) for ciphertext-looking strings
gsutil ls -L gs://partner-bucket/** | grep -E "CiQA|ciphertext" -n || true
```

lee: I can patch IAM immediately to remove roles/kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from the partner principal while Sam runs the above. I'll push a temporary binding revoke and file infra PR to make it permanent.

priya: Also: Vault side-checks — make sure any Vault auth role that exchanges partner SAs -> Vault tokens has TTL reduced and token revocation enabled. Run: `vault token revoke -prefix partner-*` where applicable (dry-run first).

maya: Partner comms: I'll ask them to rotate their side and to stop sending full logs. Need list of exact keys/tokens we disabled so they can rekey.

deploy-bot: terraform: plan for infra/iam change created by lee (PR #4921).

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-1267 (secrets-leak). Pager duty page sent to oncall.

sam: Found 3 objects with similar pattern across two prefixes. I've started a bucket copy to quarantine them to gs://redwood-sec-quarantine/ and set object ACL to private.

priya: Good — after quarantine: run a hash scan across partner buckets for matching ciphertexts and add to incident runbook. I'll enable KMS audit logs export to BQ now: `gcloud logging sinks create kms-audit-bq ...` and attach the service account.

lee: Temporary IAM patch applied. Confirmed partner principal no longer has decrypt perms. Pushed terraform PR for policy change, will await code review.

maya: Owners: sam -> revoke keys + quarantine copies, lee -> IAM patch + infra PR, priya -> audit sink + Vault revocations, maya -> partner comms and verification. Check-in in 30m. :white_check_mark:

priya: Also note: follow-up hill: add upload-side sanitizer for partner pipeline and require a minimal test to ensure no tokens make it into logs. I'll add to backlog and link to incident.

maya: Thanks — logging timestamps and actions in INC-2026-1267. Closing this thread for async updates; post any findings to the incident channel.
